title: The aim
text: Be the first to play every tile in your hand. This is the plain draw game with a double-six set, the one most tables mean.

title: Setting up
text: Shuffle the tiles face down. With two players take seven each. With three or four, most tables take five each: agree it before you start. The rest stay face down as the boneyard. The highest double goes down first.

title: A turn
text:
Add one tile to either open end of the line, matching the number of spots where they touch. Doubles are laid crossways.

If you cannot play, draw from the boneyard until you can. If the boneyard is empty, pass.

title: Ending a round
text: The round ends when someone plays their last tile, or when nobody can move. The player with no tiles, or the fewest spots left in hand, wins the round and scores the spots left in everyone else's hands.

title: Keeping score
text: Tables differ on the target: one hundred is common. I count rounds won here. Tap the winner's name after each round.
